actions.name: Split a bill privately: agree who owes what, each pays their share on the private rail
actions.partialBecause: built and tested on a shared fake LEZ chain (split_lez_test); not yet run on the LEZ testnet (a private transfer proves for minutes and needs a funded shielded account), and the hosted methods and UI speak only evm.split so far
actions.summary: The same agreement as evm.split — each debtor signs their own share with their room key — settled so the chain names no payer, no payee and no amount: the creditor shares a shielded key node, each debtor pays shielded → shielded from their own LEZ wallet, and the creditor's own scan confirms each share when a note of exactly that amount arrives. Every share is a different amount, a few base units apart, so a note can be attributed to its share without the chain naming anyone.

fields.name: chain
fields.means: the LEZ zone (CAIP-2) every share is paid on — the policy's qualifier (lez-split@<CAIP-2>)

fields.name: total
fields.means: the bill, canonical decimal in base units (9 decimals); the creditor's own share is total minus the shares

fields.name: creditor
fields.means: who fronted the bill and is owed: their room identity

fields.name: payTo
fields.means: the creditor's shielded key node, priv:<npk>:<vpk> — where each private note lands; never a public account

fields.name: shares
fields.means: [{who, amount}] sorted by who, each debtor once, never the creditor, and NO TWO AMOUNTS EQUAL — the amount is how a note is matched to its share

steps.does: Composes the split with their shielded key node as payTo and distinct shares (evenShares(distinctAmounts = true): the i-th debtor owes i base units less, the creditor absorbing them). A public payTo, an asset other than LEZ, or two equal shares is refused with its reason.
Agrees to their own share in-app with their room key, exactly as for evm.split; only a named debtor's key counts.
steps.signs: an Ed25519 signature by the debtor's room identity over the split's dCBOR materialization; plus a muster attestation over P

steps.does: Each debtor pays their derived share from their OWN shielded LEZ account to payTo on the private rail — a public source is refused, since the shield rail would name the payer and the amount — and reports it once the transfer settles. The creditor's own wallet scans: a note that arrived at payTo, of exactly one share's amount, not already claimed, confirms that share; the room records a hash of the note's id. A report without a note never confirms.
steps.signs: each debtor's own private LEZ transfer (their wallet proves and signs it); each report is signed by its author's room key

steps.does: Every share confirmed by the creditor's scan (or marked received outside muster): the split is final on every member.

refusals.what: a private split whose payTo is a public account, whose asset is not LEZ, or two of whose shares are equal
refusals.why: the private split pays only a shielded key node, and equal shares could not be told apart by amount

refusals.what: paying a share from a public LEZ account
refusals.why: the shield rail would name the payer and the amount on the chain; a private split takes only the private rail

refusals.what: confirming a share with no note of exactly that amount at payTo
refusals.why: a private payment names no payer: the note is the proof, not the payer's report
the creditor's client refuses a note it already claimed

actions.ui: not yet: the Split composer and card speak evm.split; the private rail is the next hosted / UI step

claims.claim: The chain learns only that private transfers happened: no payer, no payee, no amount
Each debtor pays from their own shielded account; a public source is refused, never quietly allowed
A share is confirmed only by the creditor's own scan finding a note of exactly that amount — never by the payer's word
Nothing makes anyone pay: the room shows who has
Whether a LEZ privacy-preserving transaction commits to a zone id is unverified
claims.party: anyone holding the transaction, on another zone

unverified: whether a LEZ privacy-preserving transaction commits to a zone/chain id
the real lez_core's scan exposes a received note's key node and amount the way the fake does
